description:
In this talk, Enrique Antonio Reyes examines leadership not as a fixed doctrine, but as a language that must evolve with the people it serves. Grounded in personal experience, from growing up under a command-and-control father to leading diverse, multigenerational teams, he interrogates why traditional models of authority often break down in modern organizations. The talk explores how control, once seen as strength, can slowly erode trust, engagement, and collective intelligence. Reyes proposes letting go as a deliberate act of leadership that creates space for connection, autonomy, and shared ownership, rather than weakness. With reframing leadership as a process of unlearning and adaptation, the talk challenges leaders to rethink how power, trust, and influence truly work in a changing world. Agile HR Enthusiast  •  Philippines’ Top 30 Leaders on LinkedIn 

Enrique Antonio “Iks” Reyes is Vice President and Head of Strategic Business Partnering at Converge ICT Solutions, Inc., one of
title: Why letting go is the new language of leadership | Enrique Antonio Reyes | TEDxRizal Avenue

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the very thing that makes your hands shake and your heart race is actually the compass pointing toward your greatest potential? In this refreshing and deeply personal talk, Kashvi—the reigning Miss Universe Telangana—dismantles the myth of "fearlessness." Sharing the story of her rescue dog, Itto, who is terrified of everything from squeaky toys to the rain, she reveals a startling truth: fear isn’t a sign of weakness; it’s a biological survival tool designed to keep us alive.
Kashvi opens up about her own battles with a childhood stutter, the paralyzing anxiety of the NEET exam, and the unconventional jump from medicine to the Miss Universe India stage. She explains the science of the amygdala and how our brains often confuse a microphone with a tiger. By reframing fear as "data" rather than "doom," she teaches us how to stop judging our discomfort and start using it as a guide. This talk is a powerful reminder that if you aren't afraid, you aren't growing. It’s time to stop
title: Why fear is my best friend and why it should be yours too | Kashvi Chawda | TEDxGIBS Bangalore

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this unsettling and profoundly honest talk, Prakash Belawadi flips the script on the theme "Imagination to Execution." Instead of celebrating success, he asks us to look at its consequences. From the toxic air of Delhi to the disappearing canals of Bangalore, Belawadi argues that our modern models of "execution" are fundamentally broken. We have built empires of wealth while breathing poisoned air and drinking contaminated water, leading him to a chilling conclusion: we aren’t just the victims of the environmental crisis—we are the architects of it.
With the sharp intellect of a journalist and the passion of an artist, Prakash challenges the younger generation to redefine what it means to be successful. He dismantles the illusion that we can "buy" our way out of planetary decline, reminding us that we share one sky, one earth, and one water supply. By weaving in heart-wrenching personal anecdotes—like his young daughter’s realization of the human cost of a simple bargain—he urges u
title: How progress is failing our planet | Prakash Belawadi | TEDxGIBS Bangalore

description:
Mauricio Serna, experto en finanzas ambientales, parte de la historia de su familia y la creación de la Reserva El Globo en las montañas de Colombia para abordar un dilema global: si la economía depende al 100% de la naturaleza, ¿por qué seguimos tratándola como un lujo y no como una necesidad? Mauricio propone un cambio de paradigma radical: tratar a la naturaleza como "infraestructura crítica", igual de esencial que las carreteras, los puentes o el saneamiento básico.

Biólogo de formación, Mauricio Serna se ha dedicado a crear soluciones para el financiamiento de la conservación de la biodiversidad. Su experiencia en Colombia con la creación de la Reserva El Globo, un proyecto de restauración y cuidado de la naturaleza a largo plazo, lo llevó a especializarse en el desarrollo y operación de Bancos de Hábitat. Actualmente, Serna ayuda a estructurar modelos de financiamiento para la biodiversidad en diferentes naciones, articulando comunidades, empresas e instituciones. Biólogo de fo
title: ¿Y si financiamos la naturaleza como financiamos las carreteras? | Maurício Serna | TEDxAmazônia

author: TEDx Talks
description:
¿Cómo se vive en un mundo donde el territorio no tiene límites y el silencio es una forma de conocimiento? La antropóloga Hortensia Caballero Arias nos lleva al Alto Orinoco, en el corazón del territorio Yanomami, para revelarnos que la Amazonía es mucho más que un ecosistema.

Nacida en Caracas, Hortensia Caballero Arias cuenta con más de 20 años de trabajo con los pueblos indígenas de la Amazonía, especialmente los Yanomami. Doctora en Antropología por la Universidad de Arizona, es presidenta de la Fundación Yanomami, jefa del Laboratorio de Antropología del Desarrollo e investigadora sénior en el Instituto Venezolano de Investigaciones Científicas (IVIC). Su investigación indaga las transformaciones culturales, históricas y políticas entre los Yanomami de Venezuela, además de procesos interculturales y derechos indígenas. Nascida em Caracas, Hortensia Caballero Arias tem mais de 20 anos de trabalho junto aos povos indígenas da Amazônia, especialmente os Yanomami. Doutora em Antropo
title: La ciencia de lo invisible: el saber de la Amazonía | Hortensia Caballero Arias | TEDxAmazônia

author: TEDx Talks
description:
É possível transformar toneladas de resíduos da floresta em uma solução para a moradia? Francielly Rodrigues, uma jovem pesquisadora de Moju, no interior do Pará, prova que a curiosidade é o motor mais potente da ciência.

Francielly superou distâncias geográficas e sociais para criar um tijolo sustentável feito a partir do caroço de açaí. O projeto a levou dos rios da Amazônia aos palcos de Harvard, mas seu verdadeiro objetivo é outro: garantir que as crianças de sua região entendam que elas não estão apenas perto da floresta — elas são a Amazônia. O sonho de Francielly é transformar Moju, município localizado a 120 km de Belém, em um polo científico. Seu interesse pela pesquisa começou aos 8 anos, quando participou de uma feira de ciências. Aos 16, ela desenvolveu um material de construção feito com caroço de açaí. Além de dar uma destinação a esse resíduo, descobriu um material barato para resolver problemas estruturais nas casas de sua comunidade. Seus projetos já renderam mais de
title: Como transformar caroços de açaí em tijolos para o futuro | Francielly Rodrigues | TEDxAmazônia

agencies walk their talk of serving everyone. Her journey started when

Chris explores a transformative philosophy that reframes personal, professional, or emotional hardships not as obstacles, but as essential catalysts for growth, innovation, and accelerated success. With a unique blend of motivational insight and tactical strategies, Chris equips audiences with tools to shift their mindset, embrace accountability, and elevate their lives regardless of circumstances. His work with leaders

author: TEDx Talks
description:
¿Qué pasa cuando dejamos de ver basura y empezamos a ver pigmentos? En esta inspiradora charla de TEDxCaracas, el artista y muralista Oscar Olivares nos relata cómo un pequeño gesto en una plaza abandonada de Caracas desató un movimiento global de arte ecológico.

De recolectar tapas en las calles de Venezuela a crear murales monumentales en Arabia Saudita, México y Suiza, Oscar nos demuestra que el arte no solo embellece espacios, sino que regenera comunidades y sana el planeta. Además, nos comparte la emocionante historia de cómo cumplió su sueño de dejar su huella en Italia, la tierra de su gran referente, Miguel Ángel. Oscar Olivares is a 29-year-old Venezuelan Fine Artist and Speaker.

He has gained national and international recognition for creating large-scale murals using plastic bottle caps, becoming the leading exponent of this artistic expression worldwide. He has successfully repurposed more than 2,000,000 bottle caps across 9 countries.

In 2019, he founded Olivares Acade
title: ¿Cómo transformar la basura en oportunidades? | Oscar Olivares | TEDxCaracas

author: TEDx Talks
description: For too long, women have been praised for being “nice” – quiet, compliant, self-sacrificing. Courtney calls time on that myth, showing that real kindness takes more courage than guilt. It’s about boundaries, truth, and the radical act of treating yourself like you matter. Courtney Byers is a women’s strength and conditioning coach, community builder, and former birth doula. For 12+ years, she has helped women build strength, confidence, and self-trust while challenging cultural expectations of “niceness.” She also founded the Seattle Wellness Society, a community centered on movement and belonging. Her TEDx talk, Be a Kind Woman, Not a Nice Woman, explores the cultural cost of “niceness” and why true kindness rooted in courage and integrity is a radical act that transforms not only women’s lives, but the world around them. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Be a kind woman, not a nice woman | Courtney Byers | TEDxSammamish Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Hana explores the shift from a fixed, static sense of self to a dynamic, evolving identity that adapts in real time to a rapidly changing world. It challenges the traditional notion that identity is solely defined by past history, career roles, or social labels. Instead, it posits that who we are is a "beautiful, mysterious essence" that can be consciously redesigned through present-moment actions and intentional, daily choices. Hana Scott is a dynamic multi-hyphenate entrepreneur, operations strategist, and community leader with a diverse background spanning biotechnology, project management, and nonprofit leadership. She is the Founder and Principal Consultant of Pugh Insights, where she brings calm to the chaos for clients by streamlining operations and driving growth through project and change management across industries including tech, pharma, education, and finance.

Equally committed to social impact, Hana’s work focuses on strengthening the operational and strategic capacity
title: Reimagining identity in real time | Hana Scott | TEDxReisterstown

author: TEDx Talks
description: Working in one of the loudest industries, Dunja Ivana Ballon started out as anything but loud. Over the years, by working with some of the most remarkable minds in the communications world, she noticed a common trait among them: none of them were average. They were different, decisive, and unafraid to stand for what they believed in. In this talk, Dunja shares what the “least average people” taught her about finding your voice, choosing kindness, and having the courage to be unapologetically yourself! Dunja Ivana Ballon poznato je lice domaće kreativne i komunikacijske scene. Direktorica je festivala i programa popularnih Dana komunikacija, netipičnog festivala kreativnosti i komunikacija koji je pod njezinim vodstvom višestruko izabran za jedan od najboljih evenata na svijetu. U ulozi direktorice HURA-e i IAB-a Croatia, vodi čitav niz ambicioznih inicijativa i uspješnih projekata kojima se osnažuje komunikacijska struka, okupljaju lideri industrije te skalira čitavo tržište veličinom
title: What I Learned From The Least Average People | Dunja Ivana Ballon | TEDxZagreb

description: Can dance help you learn languages? Drawing from a life shaped by movement and multilingualism, this talk explores how dance trains the brain for language learning, resilience, and leadership. From Ukraine to Germany and beyond, a polyglot language expert reveals how choreography, like grammar, builds memory, confidence, and cultural understanding. Blending science and personal story, this talk shows how movement unlocks mindset, creativity, and human connection. Meet Karina - Marketing and Education Professional with a focus on strategic content creation, language teaching and intercultural communication — always combining my skills across diverse roles. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

author: TEDx Talks
description:
“人生的意义不是孤独的探索，而是透过与他人的关系与连结，建立自己的支持网络。”

对生命意义的探寻，一直萦绕在黑米心头。他不断尝试，跨越不同国家与领域，从志愿服务到哲学课堂；从马拉松跑道到冥想垫，却始终无法填补内心的虚无。

直到他走向人群，在真实的对话中回望自己的内心，才慢慢触及那个关键的词：关系。正因如此，他选择将哲思结合行动，创造出 “观系游戏”、“想想签” 等对话工具，让人们在提问与倾听中，看见彼此的渴望，也重新照见自己。 

而他，也终于学会与自己和解——明白价值从不需要被证明，它本来就存在于生命之中。

“The meaning of life is not a solitary quest, but rather building the networks that support us, through relationships and connections with others.”

The question of life’s meaning has always weighed on Hymn’s mind. He searched tirelessly, crossing countries and fields, from volunteer work to philosophy seminars; from marathon courses to meditation cushions, yet nothing eased the emptiness within.

Only when he reached out to others and reflected inward through real conversations did he begin to discover a crucial word: relationships. This insight led him to turn philosophy into action, creating tools such as Relation Game and Question Shaker. These open up spaces for people, where questioning and listening uncover hidden longing
title: Life: From Meaning to Design 从人生意义到人生设计 | 黑米 Hymn Wong | TEDxPetalingStreet

description:
“种子在哪里生了根，那里就是家；心在哪里，歌就在那里唱起。”

从茨厂街的激盪岁月，到《用马来西亚的天气来说爱你》的另类国歌，友弟用歌声陪伴我们走过了 35 年。

她经历过本土创作、时代曲、摩登南洋——见证了华人音乐的起伏与转折，也把一代代人的青春与乡愁，唱成了流动的文化印记。

如今的她，不只是歌手，更是故事的转述者，把南洋的风土与歌乐重新连上线。对友弟来说，每一首歌，都是一条回家的路。

“Wherever a seed takes root, that is home; wherever the heart resides, that is where the song begins.”

From her days with the band MuziKita to the songs ???????? ?????? and ?? ???? ??? ?ℎ????ℎ ????????’? ????ℎ??, Yudi Yap has embarked on a 35-year vocal journey.

She has journeyed through local compositions, golden-era classics, and the modern Nanyang sound, witnessing the rise and transformation of Chinese music. Through her voice, generations of youth and nostalgia have been woven into a living cultural legacy.

Today she isn’t just a singer, but a storyteller who reunites Southeast Asian traditions and music. For Yudi, every song is a path that leads back home.

author: TEDx Talks
description:
It takes you to a world of experimental aviation, which explores the essence of courageous adaptive leadership. Delivered from the cockpit perspective of a test pilot, it delves into how leaders can navigate uncertainty, make critical decisions under pressure and build trust within a high performing teams. It’s not just about flying the aircraft - it’s about flying into the unknown with clarity, confidence and composure.

The audience is invited into a world where failure is not an option, and every decision can have life-or-death consequences.
Through gripping stories and hard-earned insights, the speaker reveals how the principles of flight testing-rigorous preparation, calculated risk-taking, and relentless debriefing-translate into powerful leadership tools for any industry.
This talk offers a rare, firsthand look at leadership from someone who has literally flown at the edge of possibility, inspiring listeners to lead boldly, think clearly, and act decisively in their own arenas.
title: Flying at the Edge: Leadership Lessons | Group Captain Ajay Menon (Retd.) | TEDxIMI Delhi
